'''Security Hub 62-B''' was a security station located at the [[abandoned tram station]] in the [[Old World]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="KotFE 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security Hub 62-B appears on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 10" />
